assertion: Every public tarball (schema, catalog, tooling, React) installs from its packed artifact and exposes only its declared exports, types, files, and supported engines. It holds no workspace-only entry, no `workspace:` specifier, no dependency outside the registry and the publish set, and no `@muxui/tokens`.
basis: E-P2.1-01 under the Roadmap P2.1 acceptance table, Decision 0032, and the P2.1 activation packet
command: npm-publish.yml dry run (main CI reused): pnpm generate && pnpm generate:check && node tooling/audits/repository-policy/src/release-prepare.mjs
npm-publish.yml mode=publish: promote the dry run's npm-candidate artifact, then publish the set in order (npm-publication.mjs publish-set)

crossCutting.note: P2 exit owns the Productization policy; P2.1 keeps the dense-output token budget of E-P2.1-02 (its fourth part)
P2.1 captures registry, CI, and packed-artifact data, and no consumer code, prompts, screens, or traces

disclosureBasis: Public reproducibility class (Architecture, "Evidence also carries a disclosure class"): sanitized log excerpts, digests, and registry read-backs of public packages. No consumer code, prompts, screens, or traces were captured, so SCOPE-TRUST-EVIDENCE-PRIVACY is not applicable to P2.1.
expiry: Retained as P2.1 proof for this exact release; a later release needs new E-P2.1 evidence rather than an edit

independentReview.required: an independent reviewer of a different model and harness from the authoring agents, bound to the reviewed revision (P2.1 activation packet, "Roles")

limits: @muxui/react's pack audit prints no line of its own; its pass rests on the dry run's release preparation completing for the whole set.

Supported engines are checked as the carried `engines` field, equal to the source manifest; no tarball is installed or run on another Node version. Types are held by the exports and files the audit allows; there is no separate declaration check.
nonClaims: P2.1 is not claimed complete, ready, or exited by this record; the exit condition is judged from the Roadmap, not from this root.
No stable release, support, or assistive-technology claim. Install guidance for these packages uses @next.
latest is observed, not claimed or promoted: on the registry it points at each new package's rc and stayed on @muxui/react's earlier rc (Decision 0023).

The trusted publishers of @muxui/schema, @muxui/catalog, and @muxui/tooling are not yet set up and tokenless publishing is unproved for them; the provenance of their token publish proves neither (Decision 0032 item 10, as amended).

@muxui/schema, @muxui/catalog, and @muxui/tooling each also list a 0.0.0-stage placeholder version. It is no part of the release tuple, carries no provenance, and is not claimed; npm most likely created it, which is inferred and not proved.
Recovery is prepared, not exercised. The first portfolio release has no prior tuple; restoring a prior tuple stays owed by P2 exit.
No consumer validation, clean-consumer offline proof, docs, explorer, or MCP evidence (P2.2 and P2.3).
